import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p=params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]*T**2 + p[3]/T + p[4]*np.log(T) + p[5]*T**3
            + p[6]*eps**2*T + p[7]*eps**2/T + p[8]*eps**2*np.log(T)
            + p[9]*np.sqrt(eps)*T)
